blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Saturday called on Vice President Sara Duterte to learn how to respond to accusations using evidence, instead of relying on ‘red herring’ and ‘ad hominem’ fallacies. Palace press officer Claire Castro made the call after Duterte earlier denied accusations of receiving money from dismissed policeman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., former security officer of former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco. READ: Sara Duterte denies receiving money from Velasco’s ex-aide Instead of providing evidence, Duterte simply attributed the allegations to the current administration’s alleged despair to remove her.
